//: Story Phase 17: the captain's journal, the TV listings, three lines of the beard's profile, and the old crew's register brought up to date. Every entry here waits on a Phase 17 flag.

entries.title: Ledger and Tilda
entries.notes: Two of Brogath's cut-outs, painted from memory on the Fan Mega-Pack carton. A piece of the treasure room's cloud got out and went into them. LEDGER BILLIAM, TREASURER, KNOWS MONEY. NO-NONSENSE TILDA, FIRST MATE, BROGATH, STOP. They're crew now. They fight. Mostly they correct things.

entries.title: The treasure-room door
entries.notes: Cracked once more, for a second. Every plank back, two more across it. NOT EVEN FOR FRIENDS. It stays shut.

entries.title: Captain Minutes
entries.notes: One token, one failed purchase, five minutes of Coffin Sock, all delivered to me. Ledger calls it a currency. It is not money. The converter is planked over. NO CONVERSIONS. NONE. EVER.

entries.title: Greyhook Cove
entries.notes: Ledger remembered where his books are. Tilda steered for it. We are inside a storm going round and round. Nobody is going anywhere yet.

entries.title: The Fire-Sharkstorm
entries.notes: A Fire-Waft, out of the portholes, up into the storm, and the storm caught fire in rings. Agnes put it out. Tilda's cigarette is lit. So, for a moment, was Tilda. Her corner is singed for good.

entries.title: Lord Thunderbottom
entries.where: Back to wherever the Bureau sends them
entries.notes: Lord Vaporious Thunderbottom the Seventh. Ninety-seven pages, ninety-six blank. Said things about Agnes. I said please. He went into the Fart Zone, the portholes went, and I went in after the chicken.

entries.title: Agnes the Second
entries.notes: Out of the Fart Zone in my arms. Frazzled. Feathers everywhere. Sneezes now and then. Asleep on a cushion three decks down.

entries.title: My beard
entries.notes: It puffs. On its own. A little, every so often, and people step back. Thunderbottom's grand release went straight into it.

entries.title: The Coffin Sock
entries.notes: COFFIN SOCK EVENT: PENDING. Pete wrote it on his board. Brogath is bowing out at the middle and saying everything's fine.

entries.title: The Coffin Sock Catastrophe
entries.notes: It ate the green haze. Every sash snapped out flat. We've got some of the ship back. Brogath is very proud of himself. Everyone is furious.

entries.title: The Crew He Left Behind
entries.summary: A documentary in stills: the books, the orders, the empty chair on deck, the years after, the last of them. Viewer comments. At the end the set noticed who was watching.
entries.reaction: Tilda sat up straight. Ledger cried into the MAYBE column.

entries.title: Late-Night Special: Meet the New Dead Idiots!
entries.summary: A talk show from inside the storm. Treasure chests, a hammerhead band, an audience of sharks, cartoon cut-outs, CAPTAIN MINUTES, the chicken, and two correspondents in the galley.
entries.reaction: Turning it off didn't work. Neither did the other thing.

entries.title: Thunderbottom (legendary)
entries.note: Lord Vaporious Thunderbottom the Seventh's grand ceremonial release, absorbed whole while carrying Agnes out of the Fart Zone (chapter 219).

entries.title: Beard Joint, with Frog Grog
entries.note: Garrick's improvement on the historic Beard Joint, sneezed back into it by a chicken (chapter 221). The beard has not forgiven anybody.

entries.title: Coffin Sock (the catastrophe)
entries.note: Brogath's long-brewed Coffin Sock, the big one, caught at chin height (chapter 222). It outranks the first Coffin Sock. It outranks everything.

entries.title: Ledger Billiam (aboard)
entries.summary: In a cut-out Brogath painted of him on the Fan Mega-Pack carton: an enormous tricorn, a quill held up, a ledger under his arm. Remembers everything he wrote down.
entries.incidents: Reviewed the ship's finances (SHIP ASSETS: A LOT). Invented CAPTAIN MINUTES. Got the converter banned.
entries.brogath: 'He kept my books for twenty-one years after I'd gone. Asset. Every one.'

entries.title: No-Nonsense Tilda (aboard)
entries.role: First mate. Navigator. Back aboard, cardboard, singed at one corner.
entries.summary: In a cut-out with eyebrows Brogath spent far too long on. Arms folded. Cheap-O-Rama on her back. Remembers every course she ever set.
entries.incidents: Took the helm for Greyhook Cove. Filed a ninety-seven-page application. Lit her cigarette in a burning storm.
entries.brogath: 'BROGATH, STOP. She says it and I do. I always did.'

entries.title: Old Jeb, Wobbly Ned, Elsie
entries.summary: Three more of Brogath's cut-outs, stood in a row in the crew quarters' gallery. Ned leans. Elsie is only half coloured in. Nothing has gone into them.
entries.brogath: 'I'm keeping them nice. Just in case. (Not in case of anything.)'
